A.title: Large Language Models Fail on Trivial Alterations to Theory-of-Mind Tasks

models.name: GPT-3.5

paradigms.source_paper: Perner, Leekam and Wimmer 1987; vignettes from Kosinski 2023

paradigms.name: Unexpected transfer (Sally-Anne type) false-belief task, with 4 perturbed variants (transparent, in-to-on, trusted communication, query second person)
paradigms.source_paper: Wimmer and Perner 1983; vignette from Kosinski 2023

effects.label: NO-HUMAN-REFERENCE

E.headline: GPT-3.5 passes the original false-belief vignettes but fails small, principle-preserving alterations, so apparent theory-of-mind success is not robust.

G.notes: Single model, no snapshot, temperature or query date; probabilities of single completions, no repeats, intervals or tests. No human data; adult pass criterion implied. Few handpicked variants; authors call them possible outliers. Variants differ in content (perceptual access, testimony), not only wording; one double-space wording check reported.
